objective: npm start also serves a citizen screen at / in plain HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. The screen submits, withdraws, and resubmits through the citizen routes. It lists the citizen's requests with status and history.
why: Every o2 criterion is not-verified. The citizen routes exist and are tested, and the screen needs no module code. The screen relies on the fixed listRequestsByCitizen at 6ceeb42. Prerequisites: slice-khidma-o1-reviewer-actions and samahali/khidma-live#2 are merged before this slice starts. The reviewer routes let a request reach every status, so ac2-1 and ac2-3 can be proved. Partial: ac2-3 and ac2-5 cover the citizen screen only. Consistency across both screens is checked when the reviewer screen ships. The slice also delivers the ac1-7 banner on the citizen screen only, so ac1-7 stays partial.

include: Static files from a fixed allow-list: /, /citizen.js, and /styles.css. Each file path is built from import.meta.url and never from the request.
Static routes accept GET and HEAD only. Other methods return 405. The query string is ignored.
Static responses set the correct Content-Type per file through a header override in the handler response.
Static responses set Content-Security-Policy default-src 'self' and X-Content-Type-Options nosniff. No inline script or style.
A citizen screen with a typed-in citizen id, submit, withdraw, and resubmit actions, and a list of that citizen's requests.
The DOM is built with createElement and textContent only. Every value passes through String() before display. No innerHTML.
One shared stylesheet with a distinct marker for each of the six statuses.
A visible error region that shows the message of every non-2xx response.
The fictional-demo banner in markup and style that the reviewer screen can reuse.
The layout is usable at 400px width with no horizontal scroll.
Route tests for each static file, its Content-Type, the CSP and nosniff headers, and the 405 case.
Unit tests for the pure render functions with records in all six statuses and a return note.
exclude: The reviewer screen and the reviewer queue and load routes.
The ac1-6 exports. They wait for atlas-apex/khidma-live#20.
Any framework, bundler, or new dependency (C1).
Business rules in the screen (C3). The screen shows module results only.
The request body size cap. It has its own ticket.
